name: PIONERSKY TEATR: Zanaves otkryvayetsya!
source:
It would have been an ordinary shift at the camp, were it not for one detail — the arrival of Semyon, who unexpectedly found himself in a world unfamiliar to him. The pioneers were busy preparing for an exciting event: a theater production!

Against his own wishes, Semyon found himself roped into the play as the lead actor. What challenges await him along the way? Will he be able to overcome all the difficulties and not ruin the show?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3446961537]Steam[/url]]
translation:
如果没有一个细节——谢苗的到来，这将是营地里的一次普通转变，他意外地发现自己身处一个陌生的世界。拓荒者们正忙着准备一场激动人心的活动：戏剧演出！

谢苗违背自己的意愿，发现自己被拉进剧中担任主角。一路上还有什么挑战等待着他？他能否克服重重困难，不毁了这部剧呢？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3446961537]Steam[/url]]
